versions.subject: bulk of new rules to match working UACMe UAC bypasses
versions.detection:
selection:
    IntegrityLevel: 'High'
    ParentImage|endswith: '\AppData\Local\Temp\pkgmgr.exe'
    CommandLine: '"C:\Windows\system32\msconfig.exe" -5'
condition: selection
